stories.title: External Links Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the frontend data contract for external verification links including site_name, url, link_type (registry, review, licensing), and guidance_text. Ensure strict compatibility with provider_detail_service research site outputs.

stories.title: External Link Mapping and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement frontend logic to map backend-provided research_links into standardized UI elements, including normalization of labels, deterministic ordering (NPI Registry → State Board → Healthgrades), and null-safe fallback handling.

stories.title: UI Component for External Verification Links
stories.description: Build a frontend component to display external verification links with labels, outbound indicators, and guidance text explaining each source (official registry, licensing authority, reviews).
stories.evidence: GAP: No dedicated UI component for external provider verification links currently exists in frontend

stories.title: Safe Link Handling and Validation Integration
stories.description: Integrate URL validation and safe rendering (target=_blank, rel=noopener) using backend url_guardian validation pipeline to ensure all external links are safe and reachable before rendering.

stories.title: External Links Rendering Tests and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from provider_detail_service through evaluate_care_facade to frontend rendering, including ordering, fallback behavior, and safe link enforcement.
